item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
What's New

  • Try Capnot free for 7 days — a new trial lets you use every feature before buying.
  • Redesigned keyboard-shortcut picker: each key shows as its own keycap, modifier keys (including ⌘) are captured correctly, and a shortcut can no longer be assigned to two features at once.
  • Set caption, subtitle, and bubble font sizes up to 100pt — better for large monitors and TVs.
  • New "Reset to Default" button on every settings page.
  • Clearer permission prompts: live captions and the magnifier now tell you when microphone, speech-recognition, or Screen Recording access is missing, with a one-tap link to System Settings.
  • Smoother laser-pointer trail.

Bug Fixes

  • Settings resets now take effect immediately.
  • Fixed caption and subtitle bubbles occasionally freezing at the wrong height or hanging when text changed.
  • Multi-display fixes: the toolbar and captions behave correctly across screens, and drawings no longer shift when you connect or disconnect a display.
  • Various performance and stability improvements.
